question.prompt: What number is one third of the way from \(\dfrac{1}{4}\) to \(\dfrac{3}{4}?\)

solutions.explanation:
One third of the way from \(\frac14\) to \(\frac34\) means starting at \(\frac14\) and adding one third of the distance between the endpoints. That distance is
\[
\frac34-\frac14=\frac12,
\]
so the amount to add is \(\frac13\cdot\frac12=\frac16\). The requested number is therefore
\[
\frac14+\frac16
=\frac3{12}+\frac2{12}
=\frac5{12}.
\]
The answer is \(\frac5{12}\), choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
solutions.title: Take one third of the gap
